title: Verify deal paperwork fee recalculation when adding line-item accessory
preconditions: User logged in as Sales Manager with active draft deal #9482 ($42,000 MSRP).
steps: Navigate to Deals > Active Pipeline > Select Deal #9482.
Click on 'Paperwork & Fees' tab.
Click 'Add Custom Accessory' and enter Name: 'Ceramic Coating', Amount: '$850.00'.
Verify state before switching tabs.
Click 'Carrier Shipment' tab, then click back to 'Paperwork & Fees' tab.
expectedResult: Subtotal updates to $42,850.00, applicable sales tax recalculates automatically, and added accessory persists after switching tabs.

title: Idempotent handling of duplicate webhook payloads on carrier retry
preconditions: Postman configured with Staging bearer token; mock telephony service initialized.
steps: Send POST request to /api/v1/telephony/webhook with CallSID 'CA-98234-XYZ' and status 'COMPLETED'.
Record response status code and execution time.
Immediately resend identical payload within 350ms to simulate network retry.
expectedResult: First request returns 200 OK with single log record; second request returns 200 OK with header 'X-Duplicate-Discarded: true' without generating duplicate CRM activities.

title: Preserve active multi-criteria filters during column header sorting
preconditions: Lead list contains at least 50 leads with diverse status tags.
steps: In Leads table, apply filter 'Unread AI Follow-Up' and status 'Contacted'.
Confirm filtered list displays exactly 8 matching rows.
Click the 'Last Contacted At' column header to reverse sort order.
expectedResult: Sort direction reverses while maintaining both filter chips active; list remains strictly filtered to the 8 relevant rows.

title: Boundary Value Analysis on 25.0km service radius constraint
preconditions: Service provider location configured at (31.5204° N, 74.3587° E) with max service radius set to 25.0 km.
steps: Test input at 24.9 km (Sub-boundary: Valid).
Test input at 25.0 km (Exact boundary: Valid).
Test input at 25.1 km (Super-boundary: Invalid).
Verify client UI alert and server response payload.
expectedResult: 24.9 km and 25.0 km proceed to slot selection; 25.1 km displays localized error message: 'Selected address is 0.1km outside service zone'.

title: Cross-origin iframe dynamic resize and modal positioning on mobile viewport
preconditions: Booking widget embedded into third-party HTTPS test container on iOS Safari (viewport 390x844).
steps: Open embed demo page on Mobile Safari.
Select service type and advance to date picker calendar.
Select 10:30 AM slot to open confirmation drawer.
Verify postMessage height dispatch event.
expectedResult: Parent container expands dynamically to match iframe scrollHeight; CTA button remains fully tappable above the fold with no double scrollbars.

title: Enforce Role-Based Access Control on workspace bulk lead export
preconditions: User authenticated with SDR role (standard non-admin privileges).
steps: Navigate to Leads overview page in browser.
Verify 'Export All to CSV' button presence.
Intercept request or execute manual cURL with SDR JWT: POST /api/v1/export/leads.
expectedResult: Export button is not rendered in the UI; API returns 403 Forbidden with payload: {'error': 'INSUFFICIENT_PERMISSIONS', 'requiredRole': 'ADMIN'}.

title: CSV lead ingestion with unescaped international names and UTF-8 characters
preconditions: Sample CSV prepared with 250 records containing accents (é, ñ, ü, ø) and apostrophes (O'Connor, D'Angelo).
steps: Upload test CSV via Import Wizard.
Map column 'Full Name' and 'Email'.
Execute import and review summary log.
expectedResult: All 250 records parsed and stored accurately in Postgres database with zero SQL string escape failures or truncated fields.
